purpose: Observe finite-donor percentile-bootstrap coverage under a fixed known synthetic population; do not tune to coverage outcomes.

scenarios.balanced: Three fields per donor and five cells per field.
scenarios.unequal: One to five fields per donor; each field has 1, 3 or 15 cells. Counts are independent of the measurement.

estimator: Equal field means within donor, equal donors within condition; donor-resampled 95% percentile interval.
pass_fail_criterion: None for empirical coverage. Numerical failures are reported. Coverage and its dependence on donor n are the observations.
